overview.description: The Tuttle Capital Daily 2X Inverse Regional Banks ETF (SKRE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Regional Banks Select Industry index. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds aiming to achieve 2x the return, for a single day, of the SPDR S&P Regional Banking ETF (KRE) through swap agreements with major global financial institutions. SKRE was launched on Jan 3, 2024 and is issued by Tuttle Capital.

data.title: Tuttle Capital Management Launches 2x Inverse Regional Bank ETF
data.text: GREENWICH, Conn., Jan. 04, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- via IBN -- The 2x Inverse Regional Bank ETF, (NASDAQ: SKRE), will start trading today at the Nasdaq Exchange.
